flags.issue: Cover title: the erase of 数学 still leaves a small white notch in the top of the light-blue arc under 'Mathematics' (the checked edition had the same).

'Fraction (' / 'Decimal (' labels (split parts of p21_s2 to p21_s4) are set at about 0.56 so that a gap stays before the printed ')' for writing the answer. A wider box makes the layout run up to the ')'.

'(2) Which bicycle is longer?' keeps the printed serif (2) and is set larger than (1), (3) and (4) around it. This file does not change it.

p38_s23 (second green-dot question) is set as a heading at 0.69 over two lines, larger than the matching question p38_s14 and touching the dashed frames below; same kind of text should be the same size.
p38_s12 'So many customers!' is set at 0.66 in a very small bubble; no shorter wording keeps the meaning.

Table row labels p41_s36/p41_s38 ('Decimal places in the first multiplier', 'Decimal places in the product') are set very small (0.57-0.65) in narrow fixed cells; p41_s31 heading wraps onto a second line right above the table.
Slight smudge on the wall/ground where 米 of the slanted 2.7 m label was erased.
Faint ghost marks of the erased Chinese title remain around 'Review'.

'(1) Taoqi makes gates with small squares.' and the '1 gate' label are set smaller than their siblings ('(2) Xiaoxiao ...', '2 gates') even with larger boxes.
'2000毫升' on the kettle (slanted print) stays in Chinese: setting '2000 mL' over it erased the kettle; needs a hand-made patch.
'Solution: x+2-2=10-2' is typed over the pupil's handwritten working (red -2 lost); acceptable but differs from the picture style.
The tiny printed column headers of the invoice (编号, 货品名称, 规格, 数量, 单价, 金额, 小写金额, 合计金额) are still in Chinese; there is no room to set them. The unit column (张/把) is blanked.
The 'Did You Know?' badge (p78_s30) is set at 0.54 scale because the badge is small.

The comic-book cover titles (连环画) are now set as 'Comics' at about 0.55 scale on the small dark-green covers. They can only be read when zoomed in, and there is a slight smudge where the yellow title was erased.
Flow-chart labels now sit in explicit small boxes (about 8-10 pt) so the restored arrows show; the second chart's 'Make tea' (p84_s25) is at 0.56 scale, squeezed between arrowhead and paper edge.
Pancake circle labels (p85_s8-s13) remain at about 0.71-0.75 scale; circles are too small for 'Pancake 1, front' at full size.
Vertical weekday labels under both egg graphs are set rotated at 0.57-0.76 scale (Monday, Wednesday smallest); no room in the narrow columns.
Weekday headers of both tables are set at mixed sizes (Wednesday small, Friday/Sunday full size) because the cells are narrow; legible.
Red Army name table: the English names (e.g. Wang Jiaxiang, Zhang Wentian) are set at about 0.5 scale because the name cells are narrow; legible but small.
Pupil names under the two bar charts are now set in their own cells but small (about half size); the cells are only about 30 pt wide.

The tiny handwritten notes on the column-method card in the 'Share ideas' box (扩大到原来的10倍 twice, 缩小到原来的1/100) are kept in Chinese (DROP): any English overlay covered the handwritten working. They could be added as small English notes ('10 times as large', '1/100 as large') if a hand-lettering tool exists.
The middle handwritten line (扩大到原来的10倍) on the column-method card is partly faded in the output; a restore does not reach that picture (pixel fixes act on the page's largest image).
